author: Kevin Kelly
short: Custom styles, author Undo, approved haiku and voting contests.
description: Repost eligible server messages through webhooks with keyword replacements, configurable random owo transformations, and optional English haiku formatting, then attempt to delete the originals. Public text and slash commands use the owo root. Add channel scopes, personal opt-outs, custom word and syllable dictionaries, intensity/cooldown controls, manual member transformations, and guided setup. Set persistent or expiring Owo, pirate, and robot styles per channel, with thread inheritance and a manual stylize preview. Add bounded administrator-defined word styles and author-only two-minute Undo controls that preserve copied attachments. Members can explicitly submit haiku for approval or enter timed contests with one-vote policies, automatic winners and retention limits. All new actions have slash equivalents. Repost admission is capped across the bot and per server; Discord attachments are streamed under per-file and per-message byte budgets, with busy or oversized originals retained.
install_msg: Load with [p]load owoplus. Automatic processing starts disabled. Use [p]owo preview <text> and read the cog README before [p]owo enable; transformations repost messages through webhooks and attempt to delete the originals. Enable slash commands as the bot owner with [p]slash enablecog owoplus, then [p]slash sync. Use [p]owo setup for guided settings and [p]owooptout for a personal opt-out.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild transformation settings, channel scopes/styles, custom word/style/syllable dictionaries, member probability overrides and opt-outs in Red Config. It stores explicitly submitted haiku text, author/approver/contest-creator IDs, member votes, deadlines and winner references for up to 90 days, bounded to 100 hall submissions, ten contests with 50 entries and 500 voters each, and 1 MiB combined. Original transformed-message text is held only in memory for two minutes, with at most 50 active Undo records. Ordinary chat history is not persisted. Webhooks post transformed text and copied attachments using the author display name/avatar and attempt to delete the original; Undo edits those copies and retains attachments. Discord messages and announcements remain until removed there. Red user-data hooks export personal settings, haiku/votes/attribution and active Undo text; deletion removes personal records and Undo text and anonymizes attribution on others submissions. Attachment buffers are temporary, with at most four active reposts, 8 MiB per attachment and 16 MiB per message; buffers close after completion, failure, cancellation or unload.
